item.title: UK Government plans to remove failed asylum seekers without notice
item.body: Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood has tabled proposed changes to the law to speed up removals. They would let immigration enforcement remove migrants who have unsuccessfully appealed their asylum claim, without a notice period.

photo.id: wm:Shabana Mahmood Official Cabinet Portrait, September 2025 (cropped).jpg
photo.credit: Lauren Hurley / No 10 Downing Street / OGL 3, Wikimedia Commons

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🏛️ UK Government plans to remove failed asylum seekers without notice

Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood has tabled proposed changes to the law to speed up removals. They would let immigration enforcement remove migrants who have unsuccessfully appealed their asylum claim, without a notice period.

Source: Press Association | Image: Lauren Hurley / No 10 Downing Street / OGL 3, Wikimedia Commons
UK Daily Briefing | 17 November, 12:50
